A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same FCGRAFT research, with complete main text and Appendices A–C. All 41 pages were compared using text and rendering; all 28 appendix pages are identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation benchmark evaluations, physical robot experiments, and ablations in Section 5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, physical robot, and ablation results in Section 5 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: Section 4, Algorithm 1, and Appendix B retain the same two-tier function cache, locality scoring, cache-stitching, and localized cache-patching procedures.

E1.justification: Both evaluate ALFRED, TEACh, and RLBench under Open-Composition, Open-Perturbation, and Open-Evolution, plus Office Desk Rearrangement and Cooking Workstation Preparation. Additional task scenarios in Appendix C are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Simulation comparisons retain CaP, SCoT, HELPER, LRLL, PromptBook, CAG, RAGCache, PromptCache, and EPIC. Real-world comparisons retain CaP, LRLL, and RAGCache; comparator membership in appendix analyses also matches.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendices A–C retain the same task counts, scenario construction, metrics, initialization controls, model configurations, and testing procedures. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 and Appendix C retain all analyses of cache warm-up, behavioral consistency, offloading, latency, module reuse, repair reliability, model choice and size, locality, cache initialization, and quantization. The real-world case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report three runs with seeds 1, 2, and 3, standard deviations, and Wilson 95% confidence intervals for real-world success rates. Table 17 and its explanation of 27 trials per scenario are identical.

E6.justification: Numerical results, rankings, plots, and qualitative findings in Section 5 and Appendix C are unchanged. Figure 1's visual revision retains the same example and synthesis times: 12.8/13.2 seconds for conventional CaP and 6.3/1.1 seconds for FCGRAFT.

T1.justification: The problem formulation and Equations (1)–(10), including the locality-component definitions in Appendix B, are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about function-level caching, robustness, synthesis latency, and behavioral consistency, including the same headline comparison with RAGCache.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and limitations are unchanged. Both retain the isolated-agent cache limitation in Section 6.1 and appendix qualifications concerning offloading overhead, limited physical trials, ambiguous failure feedback, and the absence of formal safety guarantees.

D1.justification: Appendices A–B retain identical software and hardware specifications, decoding and cache hyperparameters, quantization settings, prompt examples, exception-handling details, and code-access information.

R1.justification: The OmniDrive reference changes from its 2024 arXiv entry to its 2025 CVPR publication, updating the title, venue, pages, and corresponding citation year. This is a publication-metadata update for the same work; cited-work membership and research positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: Small editorial updates affect the OmniDrive bibliography entry and citation year, capitalization of cache-stitching/cache-patching labels in Figure 1, and the arXiv version/date stamp. The narrative, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is reformatted with repositioned code/cache elements and revised robot imagery and insets, while retaining its caption and timing labels. Other figures and all tables are unchanged; bibliography reflow is limited.

improvement.justification: v2 refreshes Figure 1 and updates the OmniDrive publication details, but preserves the scientific argument, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations, including identical appendices. These small presentation and bibliographic refinements leave overall clarity and scientific support essentially unchanged.
